description: Konsole's built-in F11 toggles fullscreen and Konsole consumes the key; the keytab has no F11 entry

fired.sh: swaymsg -t get_tree | python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(sys.stdin); f=lambda n: (n.get('app_id')=='org.kde.konsole' and n.get('fullscreen_mode')==1) or any(f(c) for c in n.get('nodes',[])+n.get('floating_nodes',[])); sys.exit(0 if f(t) else 1)"
